leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a styled component using Vue's single-file component structure
Apply scoped styles to isolate component CSS from the global scope
Construct reusable styled components with props for dynamic styling
Configure computed properties to manipulate styles based on component state
Bind dynamic class names to conditionally apply CSS styles
Integrate styled components into a parent component and render them
Update component styles in response to user interactions
